outcome: utilities for the processes and outcomes of TOLAC and ERCD
finding: Women considering TOLAC place high value on uncomplicated vaginal birth and uncomplicated ERCD, but experience significant decreases in perceived utility if complications or alterations to the process occur.
mod_finding: This study examined patient preferences for trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) versus elective repeat cesarean delivery (ERCD) and found that women placed high value on uncomplicated vaginal birth after cesarean and uncomplicated ERCD, but any complications or alterations to those processes resulted in decreased satisfaction.
